label: preparing
what: A secret surprise feast for the mayor's forty years of service: 200 fresh loaves on the town hall tables, eight lanterns, with the neighbour arranging the mayor's arrival at 18:00. The record confirms the provisions and lanterns were prepared and kept secret from the mayor; the mayor was only told an ordinary meeting was planned. Baker and builder were initial collaborators; freight, innkeeper, and neighbour knowingly joined/helped. Secretary is not shown knowingly helping the surprise; mayor was not told about it in the record before the meeting began at 18:00 on day 1.
